description:
Perform a Binomial Test on the 'Gender' variable to test if the proportion differs from 0.5. The dataset 'ExamAnxiety.csv' is already loaded. 

1. Open the 'Frequencies' module and select 'Binomial Test'.
2. Move 'Gender' to the variables list.
3. Verify the Test value is 0.5.
4. Enable 'Vovk-Sellke Maximum p-ratio' under Additional Statistics.
5. Enable 'Descriptive plots' under Plots.
6. Save the results as 'BinomialTestGender.jasp' in '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/'.
